notes: Contact and material parameters for the rod model (spec 04). Friction coefficients feed Coulomb friction at wall and device-device contacts. Coated values are placeholders until extracted from the Niemczyk paper's figures.

friction.pair: uncoated polymer device on vessel wall

coefficient.note: Near 0.2 for an uncoated polymer on a vessel-like hydrogel.

friction.pair: non-hydrophilic (for example PTFE-coated) wire on vessel wall

coefficient.note: Assumed equal to the uncoated polymer value (niemczyk-coatings); PTFE-coated wires were not tested there.

friction.pair: wet hydrophilic-coated device on vessel wall

coefficient.note: Every hydrophilic coating tested was below the uncoated value (niemczyk-coatings); extract per-coating values from the paper's figures.

friction.pair: wire or microcatheter inside a catheter lumen

coefficient.note: No source yet; tune with play-testing and an IR reviewer.

derivations.text: Tip load is the force in grams that bends the last 10 mm of the tip 2 mm sideways. Treating that 10 mm as a cantilever gives an effective tip bending stiffness EI = F * L^3 / (3 * delta) with L = 10 mm and delta = 2 mm. It is a small-deflection estimate (delta/L = 0.2), good enough to rank tips.
